feed.title: MTL Basketball
feed.subtitle: MTL Basketball is part of the Mountain Top League, an all-volunteer organization serving the children of West Orange, NJ since 1959.

entry.title: Coaches wanted for Winter 2026–27
entry.content:
Every MTL coach is a volunteer: parents and neighbors who said yes. Could the open spot be yours?

  • About two practices a week
  • The league provides basketballs, first aid kits, a coach’s bag, and the gym
  • First-time MTL coaches complete a background check

Interested? Fill in the short coaches form, or read more on Get Involved.

Registration is still open: $135, boys and girls leagues for grades 4–8, closing November 10. Middle school evaluation nights start October 19 at Edison Middle School. Everything is on the registration page.
entry.summary: Every MTL coach is a volunteer, and we need more for the coming season. Registration is still open until November 10.

entry.title: Registration is open for Winter 2026–27
entry.content:
MTL Basketball registration is open for Winter 2026–27, with boys and girls leagues for elementary (grades 4–5) and middle school (grades 6–8) players. MTL Basketball is an inclusive in-house league for every skill level: local teams, games in town, a focus on skill development and learning the game the right way, and above all making sure everyone has a blast.

  • $110 early bird through October 4, then $135
  • Registration closes November 10
  • The season runs December through March: practices aim to start the first or second week of December, and games begin in January

Register for the elementary league or the middle school league, or read the registration page first.

Middle school players attend one short evaluation night (about 15–20 minutes, arrive any time 6:30–8:30 pm) so we can make balanced teams. Pick any date at Edison Middle School: October 19, 21, 27, 29, or November 10.

Made the West Orange Travel Team and want to play MTL as well? West Orange Rec will send you a discount code once the team is set.

Every coach is a volunteer. Want to coach or sponsor a team? Questions go to basketball.mtl@gmail.com.

The flyer images are the current season flyers, so they show today’s details rather than the ones at the time of posting.
entry.summary: Boys and girls leagues for grades 4–5 and 6–8, with a season running December through March. Registration closes November 10.
